install.notes: The card's install block. The Python requirements install OpenCV and the GUI/analysis packages; the Dino-Lite DNX64.dll is a separate, licence-gated Windows vendor download (README.MD:115-120) and is not installed by these commands. The clone ships no LICENSE file; README.MD:221 links the MIT text, so the upstream licence is NOASSERTION/unknown as the card says.
